_why: Two answers GitHub gave to `gh api repos/<repo>/commits/<sha>/pulls`, recorded on 2026-11-12 and kept to the fields this slice reads (number, state, merged_at, head.sha) so a test reads GitHub's own shape and not one written to fit (martha#256, slice 2's read-back). Nothing else of GitHub's answer is used, and head is kept as GitHub nests it. `open` was recorded while PR 284 stood open at macula-io/martha's reviewed head, which is also a case the design asks for: the pull request's number is not its package's issue number (#284 against #251). `closed` was recorded at the head of PR 246, which landed as package #243, so an answer holding only a closed pull request is a real answer and not a shape made up to be refused. Record another with: gh api repos/<repo>/commits/<sha>/pulls --jq '[.[] | {number,state,merged_at,head:{sha:.head.sha}}]'.
